confidence_notes: I ran three web searches: one for the RBA rate and two for Saranda prices. I did not use the other three allowed searches. Food and drink anchors come from aggregated, partly crowdsourced cost-of-living sites that disagree with each other. Those sites gave cappuccino at about $2-3, beer at about $1-2.50, a cheap meal at about $4-8 and a mid-range dinner for two at about $15-30. I weighted the estimates toward July peak-season tourist-area prices. Wine came from a nightlife guide that put a glass at about 300-600 ALL, so I took a mid-range figure. No source gave a cocktail price, so I set it at roughly 3 times the beer price, a ratio I assumed rather than found. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates for July peak season. I did not search for accommodation prices or inspect any listings. They are the least certain anchors, since Saranda prices rise sharply in summer. The RBA rate is the 18 November 2026 observation, which was the latest I found.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other Albanian Riviera and coastal Adriatic/Ionian resort towns such as Ksamil, Himara and Vlora. Prices are higher than in inland Albania because of Italian, Greek and European summer tourism.
